name: openbb_options_chains
description:
Full option chain for one underlying through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.options.chains).
Returns: {symbol, contracts (total), chain: the first 100 contracts with expiration, strike, option_type, bid, ask, last price, volume, open interest, implied volatility and Greeks where the provider has them} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts intrinio or yfinance; the schema default cboe is not available, so set yfinance).
One expiry with up to 50 calls and puts: yf_options_chain (dates from yf_options_expiries). Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "SPY", "provider": "yfinance"}
